import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create a DataFrame from the given dataset
data = {'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
        'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
        'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
        'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Plot a bar chart to visualize the transaction types
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=df)
plt.title('Transaction Types')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.show()

# Plot a bar chart to visualize the hour of day
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.countplot(x='hour_of_day', data=df)
plt.title('Hour of Day')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.show()

# Plot a histogram to visualize the amount distribution
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.histplot(df['amount'], bins=10, kde=True)
plt.title('Amount Distribution')
plt.xlabel('Amount ($)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.show()

# Plot a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between amount and hour of day
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='hour_of_day', y='amount', data=df)
plt.title('Amount vs Hour of Day')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Amount ($)')
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.show()

# Plot a box plot to visualize the amount distribution by transaction type
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', data=df)
plt.title('Amount Distribution by Transaction Type')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Amount ($)')
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.show()
